title: P2 - Evidence reference
description: A citation to platform-verifiable provenance. Namespaces: obs-* (a signed envelope's observation_id, exactly as a tool returned it), ctx:* (context-pack facts, e.g. ctx:identity, ctx:prior-verdicts, ctx:dossier.<field>), policy:* (deterministic rule results, e.g. policy:error-rate). A quantity with no ref behind it is not verdict-grade evidence.
